description: Department of Labour, Labour Standards Division - Notify the Special  Allowance for a normal working day as Rs. 722.16 to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper growing & manufacturing trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper) based on the Cost of Living Index Number. This falls under public sector services and administration, specifically concerning service conditions and benefits for workers, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes). The notification does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, legal regulations, commercial registrations, elections, or judicial appointments.
